summary: There's a part of you that knows deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you read people and care on instinct and you think and talk your way through anything - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: There's a part of you that knows deep feelings and a strong need to feel safe and a fast, restless mind flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you read people and care on instinct and you think and talk your way through anything - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated. Feelings may become easier to carry when they have words. Talking things through can help emotion feel less private or overwhelming.
gift: At your best: you read people and care on instinct, and you think and talk your way through anything.
shadow: The trap: your moods run you, or you bury what you actually need - or you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
integration: Let emotional needs and thinking and speech cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Communication colored by mood; powerful when feeling and reasoning are integrated.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you read people and you think work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
